posts.en:
dsh-input-rewriter is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-rewrites the composer draft into a clearer, more executable prompt after you stop typing, using scene-aware playbooks, preserving long attachments verbatim, and numbering multi-part questions.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3e07be2eaf45a597b2b4.html
